scope.purpose: Executable specification plus a partial source-fixture contract for a future external CleanMix 0.7.0 runtime-conformance harness.
scope.included: Exact-profile process isolation, stimuli, runtime oracles, and evidence requirements for the bounded P0 and P1 cases below.
excluded: A claim that a complete runtime harness, valid row execution, or runtime receipt exists.
A claim that any matrix row has executed.
A replacement for CleanMix, Cleanroom, or their service-selection behavior.
A Recurrent Complex adapter, dependency, or special-case execution path.

behavior.claim_boundary: The rows remain planned runtime oracles. Compile-tested fixture source and invalid attempts are not row observations or receipts.

phase_fixes.role: Gate pending configuration consumption by PREINIT, INIT, and DEFAULT eligibility.
Final forward-transition fix that prompts refresh and eligible pending-config processing.

injector_handler_conformance.title: Conform injector handler names during config preparation

required_process_evidence: physical side and exact Java runtime
exact installed component paths, sizes, and SHA-256 digests
ordered defining-loader service discovery and selected service
ordered configuration admission, queued phase, consumption phase, and failure events
ordered transformer-chain epochs, exclusions, and refresh reasons
forced target loads and Foundation-custodied final defined class bytes
ordered no-op target transform-entry observations proving actual target order independently of request labels and CleanMix APPLY lines
fixture invocation counters and assertion output
observer start, end, and health independent of cleanmix.log
insufficient_evidence: a CleanMix APPLY or GENERATE audit line
a requested-order property or class-loading API call without matching no-op transform-entry observations

xfail_policy.expected_failure: Record XFAIL only when the row's named defect oracle is observed with complete required evidence.
xfail_policy.unexpected_pass: Record XPASS and require drift review; do not silently promote the row.
xfail_policy.missing_or_incomplete_evidence: Leave the row unexecuted or mark the future execution invalid, never XFAIL or PASS.

historical_control_requirement.purpose: A future harness must first reproduce the two-level load-order defect on a byte-locked historical control.

fixture_spec.hierarchy: two-level parent and child targets with overriding injector handlers

stimulus: Force transformation and definition of the parent target before the child target.
Invoke the injected path once on a parent instance and once on a child instance.

required: The independent no-op chain observer records ParentTarget entry before ChildTarget entry.
The final parent and child handler names conform as one override chain.
The parent invocation increments only the parent marker once.
The child invocation increments only the child marker once.
Foundation retains final defined bytes for both targets.
forbidden: a parent-first claim inferred only from a request label or class-loading API call
parent-body dispatch for the child invocation
duplicate handler invocation
a successful result based only on CleanMix audit output

fixture_spec.hierarchy: two-level parent and child targets with overriding injector handlers

stimulus: Request transformation of the child target before an explicit parent-target request.
Complete valid JVM definition order and invoke the injected path on both target types.

required: The independent no-op chain observer records ChildTarget entry before ParentTarget entry.
The final parent and child handler names conform as one override chain independent of target request order.
Each invocation dispatches exactly once to the body for its runtime target type.
Foundation retains final defined bytes for both targets.
forbidden: a child-first claim inferred only from a request label or class-loading API call
order-dependent final handler names
parent-body dispatch for the child invocation
duplicate handler invocation

one INIT config with a unique target and marker
one DEFAULT config with a unique target and marker

stimulus: Register all three configs before advancing the phase sequence.
Advance PREINIT to INIT to DEFAULT and force each target only at its eligible phase.

required: Prepared config sets and pending counts match every declared boundary exactly.
Each config is consumed exactly once, at its declared phase and never earlier.
For INIT and DEFAULT, phase-current set precedes service beginPhase, delegated-transformer refresh, and eligible config preparation.
INIT and DEFAULT mixin bytecode is not read before its phase is reached.
Each target marker appears exactly once in final defined bytes.
forbidden: future-phase config consumption
duplicate config selection or application
missing final defined target bytes

required: Prepared config sets and pending counts match every declared boundary exactly.

Client/common fixture mixins prevent side filtering from satisfying the oracle accidentally.

fixture_spec.trigger: configured target is the first post-registration transformable class
fixture_spec.harness_helper_state: all helper classes preloaded before registration

stimulus: Reach DEFAULT, register a DEFAULT config, and prove registration alone does not synchronously consume it.
Positively record IClassTracker.isClassLoaded(target) as false, then force the configured target as the next transformable class.

required: No consumption event occurs synchronously inside registration.
Target transform entry precedes config preparation, mixin validation, application completion, and final class definition.
Config preparation and validation occur exactly once and pending count becomes zero.
The forced target contains the unique marker in Foundation-retained final bytes and invocation produces the mixed result exactly once.
forbidden: validation or target ClassInfo resolution before target transform entry
unmodified final target bytes
duplicate selection or application

fixture_spec.source_prediction: parseTargetsWithoutCheck can promote the config, while deferred MixinInfo validation cannot run for an already-defined target

stimulus: Reach DEFAULT and force the unmodified target through final class definition.
Register its DEFAULT config, trigger an unrelated non-reentrant transform, and invoke the already-defined target.

required: The definition receipt predates config registration.
Positive class-tracker state and the baseline final-byte SHA-256 are retained before registration.
The same loaded class identity and byte SHA-256 remain after registration.
A structured config, mixin, and target-correlated target_already_loaded failure rejects the case seal.
forbidden: PASS for this must-reject condition
silent config preparation or promotion without target_already_loaded rejection
post-registration application completion or a new final definition for the target
a transformed-target success claim
fabricated retroactive final bytes
silently treating config consumption as target application

fixture_spec.hierarchy: cancellable parent injector whose parent body does not load CallbackInfo and child override that does
fixture_spec.target_order: parent target transforms before child mixin completes lazy onInit
fixture_spec.tracker_state: CallbackInfo-use inference is evaluated before child initialization completes

stimulus: Transform the parent under the declared lazy-initialization order and invoke the injected path on a child instance.

oracle.named_defect: Lazy inheritance tracking can emit ACONST_NULL for the virtual handler CallbackInfo argument even though the child override uses it.
required_for_xfail: Final bytes contain ACONST_NULL passed to the conformed virtual handler rather than a constructed CallbackInfo.
Runtime counters are child_handler=1, callback_info_null=1, and original_target_body=1.
No unrelated launch, service-selection, or fixture failure explains the result.

fixture_spec.config_state: preparation active, config removed from pending, and not yet promoted
fixture_spec.reentrant_action: controlled transformer requests the config target during that interval

stimulus: Consume the eligible config while its callback reentrantly forces the configured target.

oracle.named_defect: The reentrant target can proceed silently without its mixin while the config is no longer visible as pending.
required_for_xfail: The ordered trace is config prepare enter, reentrant target transform enter, final class definition, then config promotion.
No ReEntrantTransformerError or pending-target rejection occurs.
Foundation final bytes lack the unique marker and runtime invocation remains baseline.

fixture_spec.hierarchy: three-level base, middle, and leaf targets with plain overriding injector handlers

stimulus: Request target transformations from leaf to base, complete class definition, and invoke every level.

oracle.named_defect: Three-deep plain handler conformance remains dependent on target processing order.
required_for_xfail: Final root and middle handler names match while the leaf retains a different original name.
The root injection remains virtual to the conformed root name and a leaf instance dispatches to the middle handler.
An ordinary three-level virtual-dispatch control still reaches the leaf body.

fixture_spec.plugin_probe: record sorted canonical acceptTargets inputs at INIT

stimulus: Advance to INIT and retain the plugin acceptTargets invocation and immutable argument sets.

required: acceptTargets runs exactly once after both INIT configs prepare and before their postInitialise calls.
myTargets equals TargetPlugin.
otherTargets equals TargetPre and TargetPeer, excluding self and future TargetFuture.
Mutation of otherTargets is rejected.
forbidden: future-phase target leakage into the INIT plugin view
missing ordered plugin-call evidence

fixture_spec.fault: deterministically force handler-name conformance to emit Error conforming injector handler names
fixture_spec.cleanmix_behavior_under_probe: the affected config may still be promoted after the error is logged

stimulus: Trigger the conformance error and let the process reach the normal fixture completion boundary if possible.

required: The independent observer records exactly one conformance error with config, mixin, phase, exception class, and source identity.
The case receives a rejected seal even if CleanMix returns from postInitialise, promotes the config, and the process exits normally.
Any later config promotion is retained as evidence, not treated as recovery.
forbidden: PASS after Error conforming injector handler names
relying only on cleanmix.log for the gate

fixture_spec.configs: one unique target and counter for each real phase

stimulus: Deliver the declared repeated and backward phase signals before the final forward transition to DEFAULT.
Force all targets after their first eligible consumption boundary.

required: Requested phase signals are retained and effective phases are exactly PREINIT, INIT, DEFAULT.
Each forward transition has exactly one correlated beginPhase and refresh.
Same-phase and backward requests cause no correlated phase change, beginPhase, refresh, or config preparation.
Each config is selected and applied exactly once.
All final target bytes and counters agree with exactly-once application.
forbidden: duplicate config selection or application
future-phase consumption caused by a backward signal
a successful result without final defined bytes
